run_form_composer_task: run the form composer generator task via the mephisto operator and wait for completion
build_form_composer_generator: build the form composer React app generator with optional force rebuild and post install script
configure_shared_remote_state: configure a SharedRemoteProcedureTaskState with task data JSON and a JS function registry mapping
read_task_data_config: read the task_data.json config file from the form composer generator data directory
launch_and_wait_task_run: launch a mephisto task run with shared state then wait for completion before shutdown
